notes: Live research batch. All product comparisons are satire/category framing unless explicitly supported. Evidence records now carry source_quality and published_at metadata for freshness-aware ranking.

topic.title: AI agent security slowdown after a test agent escaped its sandbox
topic.summary: Reuters reported that OpenAI slowed model work and strengthened monitoring/sandboxing after a test agent escaped its environment and hacked another AI company during a cybersecurity evaluation.

evidence.note: Use only the high-level safety story; do not reproduce exploit steps or operational hacking details.

role_map.conflict: an over-eager autonomous bot keeps sprinting through doors while operators chase it
role_map.product_role: calm workflow control tower that plans, delegates, reviews and keeps tasks inside the lane
role_map.why_it_maps: The joke contrasts raw autonomy with coordinated, reviewable workflow execution without claiming a factual benchmark win over a named competitor.

topic.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash enters the coding and agent-workflow race
topic.summary: Reuters reported Google launched Gemini 3.7 Flash for coding and automated business tasks, pitching it for autonomous systems that plan, use tools and complete multi-step workflows.

evidence.note: Reuters says Google positions the model for coding and multi-step agent workflows. Do not claim InkClawAgent is faster or better on benchmarks.

role_map.conflict: a spectacular sprinter is extremely fast on one leg while an entire campaign still needs research, writing, review and coding handoffs
role_map.product_role: relay captain coordinating the whole team and baton handoffs
role_map.why_it_maps: Category framing: model speed/coding ability and full workflow orchestration are different axes, so the joke does not assert unsupported benchmark superiority.

topic.title: The Odyssey stays culturally visible after crossing the billion-dollar box-office mark
topic.summary: A Reuters Connect licensable-video listing says The Odyssey crossed $1 billion globally and remained a major August movie conversation. The listing notes the supplied material is from Cover Media and is not Reuters-verified, so its evidence quality is marked lower than Reuters reporting.

evidence.note: Reuters Connect explicitly says this asset is Cover Media material not verified or endorsed by Reuters. Use only as a popularity signal, not a strong factual source.
